title: Known deviations
description: An implementation's deviation list (design ch. 4.3). Cross-checks against the catalogue are in harness/deviations.ts. Every entry in a list needs `expect`; result files from before it existed embed entries without it (`$defs/entry`).

cause.description: Groups entries that one fix closes.

tracking.description: An issue: HAP-123, HAP-388 (PR 6), owner/repo#12, or an https URL.

revisions.description: The revisions this entry covers (keys in spec/revisions.json). Without it, every revision the assertion applies at. An assertion may be listed once per revision, so each revision can expect its own failure.

expect.description: The failure this deviation covers. A fail whose message or evidence doesn't match is 'deviation changed', which fails the gate, so a known deviation can't hide a new failure on the same assertion.

message.description: A regular expression (JavaScript, unicode mode) the whole result message must match. It is anchored on both ends by the harness.

evidence.description: Per evidence key, a regular expression the whole value must match. A string value is matched as it is; any other value as its JSON. A listed key that's missing from the evidence is a mismatch.
